name: Gordunni Outpost
summary: North of Lariss Pavilion, the Gordunni ogres hold a fortified camp in the cliffs. Their presence leaves the surrounding wilderness dry and withered.

sections.title: A Blighted Foothold
sections.body:
Above Lariss Pavilion, Gordunni ogres patrol trails cut into Feralas's northern mountains. Their magic and destructive ways drain life from the wild. Plants die, and the hillsides lie bare.

Dirt paths lead to a shallow cave entrance and a larger mound burrowed into the rear cliffs. Hillguards, channelers, and tamers guard the camp. Near the deeper den, they keep Bigfist, a captured sasquatch, in crude confinement.

faq.q: Why is the landscape withered around this outpost?
faq.answer: The Gordunni clan's sorcery and destructive occupation drain life from the surrounding soil. Jungle plants wither, and the ground turns dry and brown.

faq.q: What kinds of ogres occupy the Gordunni Outpost?
faq.answer: Gordunni Hillguards defend the outpost, Gordunni Channelers wield crude offensive magic, and Gordunni Tamers watch over the camp and its captive beasts.
Bigfist is a massive sasquatch held captive by the Gordunni ogres near the entrance to their rear cave. The tamers keep him bound as a trophy or for experiments.

faq.q: Where is the Gordunni Outpost located?
aliases: how to get to gordunni outpost
faq.answer: The Gordunni Outpost sits high in the mountain ridge north of Lariss Pavilion in eastern Feralas.

angles.text: As a druid, you see the Gordunni's presence harm nature. The fertile jungle canopy lies withered and barren.
As a hunter, you see ogre tamers capture and abuse mountain beasts. They keep creatures such as the great sasquatch Bigfist bound in cages.
